title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00043 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Closed swab valve and continued bleeding off remaining pressure in well back to cement unit. Read 274 bar on DHPG, indicating DHSV in closed position.
00:15 - 00:30: Rigged up lifting arrangement to lift off cement spool
00:30 - 02:00: Released connection between XT and cement spool. Lifted cement spool off of XT and landed cement spool in moonpool.
02:00 - 02:45: P/u BPV plug from HTS. RIH and installed BPV plug in th. Meanwhile pressure tested BOP.
02:45 - 04:00: Installed lifting cap on XT. R/d and removed production flange from XT. Meanwhile pressured up ASV control line to 520 bar, no pressure increase on a-annulus observed. Pressure tested BOP.
04:00 - 04:15: Performed TBT with new ongoing crew
04:15 - 04:30: R/d chicksan and piping from XT
04:30 - 05:00: Removed instrumentation on XT and r/d scaffolding
05:00 - 06:00: Pulled split hatch. Pulled hatch on nabour well and r/d support beam. Built scaffolding around open hatches.
06:00 - 06:15: Performed TBT for lifting XT
06:15 - 06:30: R/u lifting arrachement on TDS
06:30 - 07:00: Lifted XT from XT-DECK to moonpool. Meanwhile pulled foxhole
07:00 - 08:15: Load transfered XT from TDS to moonpool gantry crane. Moved XT into moonpool and landed on skid. Secured XT on skid. Meanwhile prepared to lift spool piece from WH.
08:15 - 08:30: Installed master bushing and hole cover.
08:30 - 09:30: Verified no pressure in th void ports. Removed hatck on XT-DECK. Meanwhile installed foxhole.
09:30 - 10:15: Removed master bushing and lowered lifting arrangement from TDS. Attached lifting arrangement to spacer spool. Lifted spacer spool from WH to drill floor and l/d same.
10:15 - 11:00: Installed support beam and hatches. Installed split hatch on f-14. Installed master bushing and hole cover.
11:00 - 14:15: Cut control lines in multibowl. Prepared to install communication collar. Installed dart in BPV plug
14:15 - 15:30: Installed communication collar. Meanwhile pressure tested BOP.

sections.text: Closed swab valve and continued bleeding off remaining pressure in well back to cement unit. Read 274 bar on DHPG, indicating DHSV in closed position.
Rigged up lifting arrangement to lift off cement spool
Released connection between XT and cement spool. Lifted cement spool off of XT and landed cement spool in moonpool.
P/u BPV plug from HTS. RIH and installed BPV plug in th. Meanwhile pressure tested BOP.
Installed lifting cap on XT. R/d and removed production flange from XT. Meanwhile pressured up ASV control line to 520 bar, no pressure increase on a-annulus observed. Pressure tested BOP.
Performed TBT with new ongoing crew
R/d chicksan and piping from XT
Removed instrumentation on XT and r/d scaffolding
Pulled split hatch. Pulled hatch on nabour well and r/d support beam. Built scaffolding around open hatches.
Performed TBT for lifting XT
R/u lifting arrachement on TDS
Lifted XT from XT-DECK to moonpool. Meanwhile pulled foxhole
Load transfered XT from TDS to moonpool gantry crane. Moved XT into moonpool and landed on skid. Secured XT on skid. Meanwhile prepared to lift spool piece from WH.
Installed master bushing and hole cover.
Verified no pressure in th void ports. Removed hatck on XT-DECK. Meanwhile installed foxhole.
Removed master bushing and lowered lifting arrangement from TDS. Attached lifting arrangement to spacer spool. Lifted spacer spool from WH to drill floor and l/d same.
Installed support beam and hatches. Installed split hatch on f-14. Installed master bushing and hole cover.
Cut control lines in multibowl. Prepared to install communication collar. Installed dart in BPV plug
Installed communication collar. Meanwhile pressure tested BOP.
P/u surface hi-pressure riser. Attached lifting arrangement to TDS, using double securing.
Removed hatch cover in moonpool. Removed master bushing. Installed scaffolding around rotary.
Lowered surface hi-pressure riser onto multibowl.
Built scaffold around BOP test stump. Meanwhile prepared BOP for moving to well center.
Disconnected nt2 connector on test stump and removed test mandrel from BOP.
Lifted BOP from test stump and moved BOP approximately 1m towards well center.
Performed TBT for inspecting nt2 connector
Inspected nt2 connector. Meanwhile built scaffolding around HP riser in moonpool. Cleaned and cleared moonpool. Removed flange from kill wing on XT.
Performed TBT for skidding BOP
Skidded BOP over well center. Installed seal ring. Landed BOP on connector.
Installed slick joint.
Installed master bushing. Lifted diverter with TDS. Removed master bushing and lowered diverter.
